messages:
Ava (Finance): Quick flag — AtlasWorks renewal invoice looks off. Platform fee billed full year after their support tier dropped mid-term. Also a $4,800 onboarding credit is on the bill but CS says it was consumed. Can we triage?
Liam (Acct): Which invoice? I see INV-99211 created yesterday.
Ava (Finance): INV-99211, renewal effective 2026-02-15. Support tier moved from Enterprise -> Standard on 2026-02-01 per amendment.
Raj (Sales): Sales signed amendment (AMND-210) and PO-4602. Customer expects pro-rata on platform fee for remainder of year.
ops-billing-bot: invoice generated: INV-99211 at 2026-03-07T08:22:10Z. Items: platform_fee: $72,000 (annual), support_standard: $18,000 (annual), credits: -4800 LC-210.
Liam (Acct): Running a quick check. Looks like billing job used original annual charge, not prorated. Credit LC-210 still applied.
Elena (CS): Confirmed via support thread that LC-210 was consumed for onboarding services in Q4. I can upload the email trail.
Maya (Finance Ops): Do we have clause in amendment about proration? Need exact language before issuing credit memos.
Raj (Sales): Clause 3.a: "Platform fees will be billed pro rata for partial or mid-term changes to support tiers." Signed 2026-02-05.
Liam (Acct): SQL: SELECT invoice_id,item,amount,credits FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id='INV-99211'; returned platform_fee=72000, credits=-4800.
Ava (Finance): Two action items: (1) remove LC-210, (2) replace full platform fee with prorated amount for 10.5 months remaining. Who can approve the net adjustment?
Maya (Finance Ops): Ops can sign credits up to $10k. Above that needs Sr Finance.
Liam (Acct): Pro rata calc: 72k annual -> monthly 6k. Remaining 10.5 months -> 63,000. So we overcharged 9,000. With the 4,800 wrong credit, net customer owes less; net adjustment required is $4,200 credit to customer. That's within Ops $10k.
Ava (Finance): Good, Ops can approve then. Maya, can you approve $4,200 CM? Also please update proration rules so future mid-term tier changes trigger proration job.
Maya (Finance Ops): Approving $4,200 credit memo. I'll patch billing rule and add a test to the billing regression suite.
Liam (Acct): Created credit memo CM-2026-045 for $4,200. Voided INV-99211 and reissued INV-99300 with platform_fee_prorated=63,000, support_prorated=13,500, no LC-210.
ops-billing-bot: invoice voided: INV-99211 by Liam (Acct) at 2026-03-07T09:03:44Z. new invoice INV-99300 created.
Raj (Sales): Notified AtlasWorks and asked if they want the credit applied to next invoice or refunded.
Elena (CS): Customer replied: "Please apply credit to next cycle and send updated invoice. Thanks." Attached email.
Ava (Finance): Thanks. Maya please confirm when rule patch is live and add link to the PR. Liam, post updated invoice and CM to portal and mark ticket resolved.
Maya (Finance Ops): Rule deployed (PR #5623). Added unit test and a nightly job check.
Liam (Acct): Done — INV-99300 and CM-2026-045 posted to customer portal. Marking ticket FIN-7805 resolved.
Ava (Finance): Closing thread. Notes: reference AMND-210 and PO-4602 in the memo. CS evidence attached. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
